title: hepetis staminea var. longicauda
intro: Hepetis staminea var. longicauda, commonly known as Chinese Lavender or Sweet Lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its calming and relaxing properties, and is used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Hepetis staminea var. longicauda include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
